source.title: Some Open Questions about Random Walks, Involutions, Limiting Distributions, and Generating Functions

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for record 1713318. The direct zbMATH page returned a blocked_or_challenged Cloudflare 403 response when fetched locally.

zbMATH API resolved the exact work to Lou Shapiro, DOI 10.1006/aama.2001.0751, PII S0196885801907511, title Some Open Questions about Random Walks, Involutions, Limiting Distributions, and Generating Functions, Advances in Applied Mathematics 27(2-3), 585-596 (2001).

Bounded recovery attempted DOI, Crossref, OpenAlex, Unpaywall, DBLP, ScienceDirect, Elsevier API, and exact-title/PDF searches. ScienceDirect PDF/article endpoints returned blocked_or_challenged 403 responses; Elsevier API returned only minimized metadata or unauthorized responses; OpenAlex and Unpaywall reported closed access with no repository full-text copy; DBLP, Crossref, INIST/Pascal, and search results were metadata-only. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered.
Saved JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/1713318.json and outputs/latest.json.
